title: Sealed Dungeon nearest to you
caption: At level 15, after turning in a quest at Dredgion Crash Site, Next up suggests the open Sealed Dungeon of your band nearest to where you are.

title: Regional quests nearest first
caption: At level 30, after picking up a quest in Uruthumheim, the regional quest list starts with the quests nearest to where you are.

title: Stronghold nearest to you
caption: At level 40, after a quest turned in at Western Gribade Highland, Next up suggests the open stronghold nearest to you.
